description: This file contains controller functions for user authentication, including registration, login, password reminder, and password reset, utilizing external modules for hashing, token generation, email notifications, and database interactions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user, saving it to the database, and sending a welcome email.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying email and password, then issues a JWT token.

methods.name: remindPassword
methods.description: Generates a password reset token, saves it with expiration, and sends a password reminder email.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets the user's password if the provided token is valid and not expired, then sends a confirmation email.
